title: Quantum Monte Carlo in Classical Phase Space with the Wigner-Kirkwood Commutation Function. II. Diagonal Approximation in Position Space
summary: A third order expansion for Wigner-Kirkwood commutation function, a complex function in classical phase space that accounts for the Heisenberg uncertainty relation, is approximated and integrated over momentum to give a real function in position configuration space. Metropolis Monte Carlo computer simulation results are given for liquid Lennard-Jones $^4$He below 10\,K.
